Chagala @ Binod Kumar Naik .... Petitioner
 Mr. B. Sahoo, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc
 Mr. S.P. Dash, Adv. (Informant)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Learned counsel for the Petitioner is permitted to correct the description of the case number in Court.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.
3.
The Petitioner is an accused in T.R. Case No.139 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl.

District Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Nayagarh, arising out of Nayagarh Sadar P.S.
Case No.98 of 2022.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Special Court under POCSO Act, Nayagarh by order dated 6.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 29.06.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 27.08.2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(3)/304-B IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and considering the pre-trial detention, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State and the Informant oppose the prayer for bail relying on the Chagala @ Binod Kumar Naik vs State Of Odisha ....

entities.text: Chagala @ Binod Kumar Naik vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25544503/
1 statement of C.W.3 father of the victim.
They further submit that since trial has already commenced the Petitioner ought not to be released on bail at this stage.

7. Perused the statement of C.W.3 and also the post-mortem report.
8.

Considering the same and the background in which the allegation has been leveled, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin to ensure his presence on each date of trial.

9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
